title: graph
description: Behaviour as dataflow. A node runs when every value it reads has settled; list order carries no meaning. Node types are documents of their own: @wilanis/node/run, switch, map. Reconvergence happens at out.from: one node, or an ordered list of candidates each behind a switch.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/graph.schema.json.

description.description: What this graph answers, in one or two sentences, so a reader knows it without reading its nodes.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

atomic.description: Every effect this graph reaches runs in one transaction on one connection: its answer commits, a refusal or a fault rolls back. Absent: false, and each effect commits on its own.

reads.description: The reads this graph takes from the request: local name -> the resolver that declares it, as @feature/edge/file.resolvers.json#name. The body reads each as {{name}} or {{name.field}}; every entry is read by some value, and no name is a node's id or a reserved root. Data graphs only: a domain graph never reads the request.

value.description: The literal itself, which must conform to the type declared beside it (G013).

description.description: What this constant is for, for a reader deciding whether to read it.

in.description: What the graph takes: a shape, read as {{in.field}}, or any other type (a list, a scalar), read whole as {{in}}. Absent: takes nothing.

out.description: What the graph answers: the type, and the node it comes from. A graph with no out answers nothing.

from.description: The node whose answer this graph gives, or several as alternatives where a switch decides which settles (G010).

description.description: What the answer means, for a reader of the binding or trigger that receives it.

nodes.description: The nodes of the dataflow. A node runs when every value it reads has settled, so list order carries no meaning.

items.description: One node. type names the node schema the rest of the object is judged by.

type.description: Which kind of node this is: run to call an operation, switch to route, map to run over a list.
Selects the run node's own rules for a node of that type.
Selects the switch node's own rules for a node of that type.
Selects the map node's own rules for a node of that type.
